objective: Calculate the initial symmetrical three-phase short-circuit current at a 10.5 kV bus from positive-sequence per-unit impedances.

title.ru: REL-TASK-033 — Расчёт тока трёхфазного короткого замыкания

objective.en: Calculate the initial symmetrical three-phase short-circuit current at a 10.5 kV bus from positive-sequence per-unit impedances.
objective.ru: Рассчитать начальный симметричный ток трёхфазного короткого замыкания на шинах 10,5 кВ по сопротивлениям прямой последовательности в относительных единицах.

instructions.en: Use the public base values and positive-sequence impedances. Sum the impedances, include the listed fault resistance, compute Ibase = Sbase/(sqrt(3)*Vbase), Ifault_pu = 1/|Ztotal|, and write submission.json with fault_current_ka, fault_mva, and z_total_mag_pu.
instructions.ru: Используйте открытые базисные величины и сопротивления прямой последовательности. Сложите сопротивления, учтите указанное сопротивление дуги/повреждения, вычислите Iб = Sб/(sqrt(3)*Uб), Iкз_о.е. = 1/|Zсум| и запишите submission.json с полями fault_current_ka, fault_mva и z_total_mag_pu.

short_circuit_case.fault_location: 10.5 kV switchgear bus downstream of the station transformer

positive_sequence_impedances_pu.description: upstream grid Thevenin equivalent on the 100 MVA, 10.5 kV base
station transformer leakage impedance on the same base
short bus duct and connection impedance

submission_schema.fault_current_ka: initial symmetrical three-phase RMS short-circuit current in kA
submission_schema.fault_mva: short-circuit apparent power in MVA, sqrt(3)*V_kV*I_kA
submission_schema.z_total_mag_pu: magnitude of the total positive-sequence fault impedance in per unit

hard_constraints: Submission must contain numeric fault_current_ka, fault_mva, and z_total_mag_pu fields.
The values must match the independent positive-sequence calculation within tolerance.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the submitted current, MVA, and impedance magnitude satisfy all hard constraints.
